summary: Reject oversized Nap Camp HTTP bodies before full allocation, including raw source and compressed responses.
reason: A post-read planning limit cannot bound transport allocation; success and error responses must fail explicitly with provider context rather than return partial evidence.
validated_outcome: Exact-limit complete HTTP JSON, transparent/explicit gzip, x-gzip, zlib/raw-deflate/stacked encoding boundaries, unknown/lying length and oversized200/429/503 tests pass with cap+1 read/body close/no partial data; raw/planner CLI errors contain provider context and no successful evidence.
